title: The 5 Best Food Dehydrators for Herbs
h1: The 5 Best Food Dehydrators for Herbs
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for food dehydrators for herbs, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at food dehydrators for herbs using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: NESCO FD-75A Snackmaster Pro Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: Adjustable thermostat down to 95°F, 5 trays included, expandable to 12, Compact stackable design.
strengths: 95°F floor is low enough to preserve herb color and aroma
Compact size is easy to fit on a counter for a quick batch of a few herb varieties
Lowest price on this list for anyone drying herbs occasionally
Expandable trays let you add capacity later if you start drying more
limitations: Mesh screens for small leaves are sold separately, not included
Top-mounted fan means the top tray dries noticeably faster than the bottom
5-tray starting capacity limits how many herb varieties you can dry in one batch
features: Mesh screens available as an accessory

products.name: COSORI Premium 10-Tray Stainless Steel Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: 95°F to 165°F in 1°F increments, 10 stainless steel trays, 16.2 square feet of drying space, Rear-mounted horizontal airflow.
strengths: 1°F increments make it easy to hold precisely at 95°F to 100°F for the most delicate herbs
10-tray capacity dries an entire garden's worth of different herb varieties in one run
Horizontal airflow means every tray finishes at close to the same time
Large drying area keeps different herbs separated by tray to avoid flavor crossover
limitations: More capacity than most home herb growers need, especially early on
Higher price than the NESCO for occasional small-batch drying
Mesh screens for small leaves sold as an accessory, not included
features: 10 stainless steel trays, 16.2 square feet of drying space
48-hour digital timer, useful set to short cycles for herbs

products.name: Presto 06301 Dehydro Digital Electric Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: Digital thermostat down to 90°F, 6 trays included, expandable to 12, Nesting trays for compact storage.
strengths: 90°F floor goes even lower than the NESCO and Excalibur for the most delicate herbs
Mesh screens included out of the box, no extra purchase needed for small leaves
Nesting trays make this the easiest to tuck away when not drying a batch
Digital timer is easy to set for the short 1 to 4 hour cycles herbs need
limitations: Bottom fan dries the lowest tray fastest, so checking trays individually helps
6-tray starting capacity is modest for drying several herb varieties at once
Round trays leave some unused space compared to square-tray competitors
features: Includes mesh screens in the box

products.name: Excalibur D900CDSHD 9-Tray Food Dehydrator
products.blurb: Key specs: 9 stainless steel trays, 15 square feet of drying space, Adjustable thermostat, 105°F to 165°F, Parallex horizontal airflow.
strengths: 9 separate trays make it easy to dry many herb varieties at once without flavor crossover
Horizontal airflow dries every tray at nearly the same rate for consistent batches
Stainless steel trays clean up easily after resinous herbs like rosemary
Largest drying area on this list for a full end-of-season herb harvest
limitations: 105°F floor is higher than the NESCO, COSORI, and Presto, less ideal for the most delicate herbs
Highest price on this list, more than most home herb growers need
Large footprint takes meaningful counter or storage space
features: 9 stainless steel trays, 15 square feet of drying space

products.name: NESCO FD-37A 4-Tray Food Dehydrator
strengths: No tray rotation needed
Expandable to 7 trays
Trays and base are dishwasher safe
Low price
limitations: Fixed 160°F is hot for delicate herbs

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
